trace_matrix.requirement: All screens meet WCAG 2.1 AA and Section 508
trace_matrix.notes: Contrast (C-01) and keyboard access (C-02) are the WCAG checks named in the rule catalog; Section 508 applies via CA Gov. Code 7405 (C-03). C-04 certification is posted by the agency, but our conformance reports feed it.

trace_matrix.requirement: Mobile-first layouts for screens 360 px and wider
trace_matrix.notes: Section 508 covers all state ICT, including mobile layouts. Mobile users currently take twice as long as desktop users (RFP background).

trace_matrix.requirement: Renewal completed in 10 minutes or less by a first-time user
trace_matrix.notes: The automatic logoff required by C-06 must not interrupt a renewal that takes up to 10 minutes. How the 10 minutes is measured is not defined (see unclear clauses).
No rule in the catalog covers reading level; it is a contractual requirement only. The Kansas plain-language guide (KS-CT-01) is the likely basis.

trace_matrix.requirement: All content available in English, Spanish and other threshold languages
trace_matrix.notes: Addendum Q2 limits the first release to English and Spanish; the other threshold languages follow the state's list with no stated timing.

trace_matrix.requirement: Save and resume an application for 30 days
trace_matrix.notes: Saved applications must survive the C-06 session logoff and be protected on resume under state security controls such as MFA (C-12).

trace_matrix.requirement: Document upload by phone camera with quality check
trace_matrix.notes: Uploaded documents can contain health information: show only what is necessary in previews and confirmations (C-05), and error messages must not leak data (C-12).

trace_matrix.requirement: No PHI shown in notifications or page titles
trace_matrix.notes: Directly implements the minimum-necessary rule (C-05) and the CMIA privacy review of notifications and page titles (C-07).

trace_matrix.requirement: Design system delivered in Figma with coded tokens
trace_matrix.notes: Colour tokens must encode contrast-compliant pairs (C-01); the system is state ICT under Section 508 (C-03).

trace_matrix.requirement: Usability testing with at least 40 participants across 3 rounds
trace_matrix.notes: We handle participants' personal data only as a service provider (C-09). The scope requires including people with disabilities but sets no number (see unclear clauses).

trace_matrix.requirement: Session timeout warning with option to extend
trace_matrix.notes: The HIPAA Security Rule entry (C-06) requires automatic logoff with a warning, so this is effectively mandatory even though the RFP marks it Should (see unclear clauses).

trace_matrix.requirement: The new design must feel modern and intuitive
trace_matrix.notes: Not measurable as written and maps to no compliance rule. The RFP itself notes this requirement is deliberately vague.

unclear_clauses.issue: "Modern and intuitive" has no measure, so it cannot be accepted or rejected objectively.
unclear_clauses.drafted_question: R-12 asks that the design "feel modern and intuitive". How will the state assess this at acceptance? Would the state accept a measurable target instead, such as a System Usability Scale score or task success rates from the R-10 usability tests?

unclear_clauses.issue: The 10-minute target does not say how it is measured: which users, how many, what share must succeed, and in which test setting.
unclear_clauses.drafted_question: For R-03, how will the 10-minute renewal target be verified? Please confirm the measure (for example, the median time of first-time participants in the R-10 usability tests) and whether time spent gathering documents is included.

unclear_clauses.issue: "Other threshold languages" are not listed, and Addendum Q2 defers them to the state's current list with no date or count, which makes translation impossible to price.
unclear_clauses.drafted_question: Further to Addendum Q2, which threshold languages beyond English and Spanish are in scope for this contract, and in which month of the 6-month term must each be delivered? Are translations of the full content required, or only member-facing screens?

unclear_clauses.issue: R-11 is marked Should, but compliance rule C-06 (HIPAA Security Rule) requires automatic logoff with a warning.
unclear_clauses.drafted_question: R-11 (session timeout warning) is listed as Should. Given HIPAA Security Rule requirements for automatic logoff, may we treat it as a Must and design the timeout and warning together with save and resume (R-06)?

unclear_clauses.issue: The scope requires testing with people with disabilities, but R-10 sets no minimum number of them among the 40 participants.
unclear_clauses.drafted_question: For R-10, is there a minimum number of participants with disabilities, or specific disability groups the state expects in each of the 3 rounds?

open_questions.question: Rule C-08 (notice at collection on state forms) applies to the apply and renew form screens, but no RFP requirement names it. Should we add it to scope as a content deliverable?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Without a requirement it may be missed in the design and in acceptance, yet it is a legal obligation on state forms.

open_questions.question: How will reading level (R-04) be measured at acceptance: which readability formula, and does it apply to the Spanish content too?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Without an agreed measure, content can be disputed at acceptance of D4 and D6.

open_questions.question: Rules INT-01 and INT-02 govern our agent workflow rather than the product; should they appear in the compliance matrix exhibit of the contract?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Decides whether the state sees our AI controls as a contractual commitment.

rad_impacts.note: Trace matrix covers all 12 requirements with rule mappings; the risk drops once the solution architect and compliance officer complete the 100% review at H2.
Five written questions are drafted (R-12, R-03, R-05, R-11, R-10) and ready to submit before the Nov 13 deadline.
The R-05 question asks for the list and timing of other threshold languages; the answer will fully validate or invalidate this assumption.
Compliance gap: notice at collection (C-08) is not covered by any requirement. Suggested owner: compliance officer.
